Mandatory Stats: Make sure to fill out your resist, you want 75% fire/cold/lightning resist. Chaos resist is good, but not mandatory to have 75%, I usually aim for 30-50%. You'll also most likely need 1-2 attribute rolls on gear, belt will solve strength and if you need intelligence, get it on a ring or amulet.

Rings/glove: try to focus on high flat damage to attacks, preferable cold/phys.

Bow: You want the highest dps ele/phys weapon you can afford. 
Obliterator Bow
 is usually the go to, as it has very high base damage and the downside is negligible.  Check the notes at the bottom of the guide to learn how to craft a bow.

Greater Iron Rune
 will provide the highest dps.

Quiver: Just good dps stats, high flat/bow dmg or projectile speed with attack speed. Ideally just aim for 3-4 stats from the quiver I'm showing in the gear preview.

amulet: Preferable want +proj levels. Crit chance/crit damage is also good, once you swap to crit. Attributes/resist are also fine here. You need at least 30 spirit on the amulet to use all spirit gems.

Helmet: At the start just look for a high life/evasion/resist helmet, eventually we'll swap to a pure ES helmet with 
Subterfuge Mask
, but you probably wont have a good one for early mapping.

Chest: you want the highest evasion chest you can afford, this is very important for defense, specially when combined with 
Beastial Skin
 on the passive tree. use 
Greater Iron Rune



Boots: You want the highest movement speed boots you can afford, it's a very important stat. Besides that look for high life/resistance.

Belt: Not a lot of choices here, just Life/str/resist, eventually you want to get a 
Headhunter
.

Rarity is still really good in 0.5, I would try to hit at least 100% if you want to farm efficiently (don't focus on this if you feel like you're lacking damage or defense)

Jewels on tree: Just looking for generic damage: attack damage, elemental damage, movement speed, bonus from quivers, projectile damage, attack speed, crit chance, crit damage, etc.
Eventually you'll also want 
Heart of the Well
 with double "gain as extra" and 
Against the Darkness
 with double again as extra as well.

important:
You'll want 1 sapphire jewel with mana on kill to sustain mana during mapping. For bosses, having 
Mark of Siphoning II
 on 
Freezing Mark
 with 
Eternal Mark
 should give you enough sustain.

Anoint:
Damage: 
Serrated Edges

This is just a cheap anoint and pretty effective when you eventually swap to crit.

---Mana Issues
There's a few things you can do here to help out your mana sustain and I'll list them all here.
Reminder: Always run one jewel with 2% mana on kill.

1) Run a regular mana flask with increased recovery and just use your mana flask button, this along with a 2% mana on kill jewel will easily sustain you
2) Take 
Conservative Casting
 for 3 passiv points.
3) Drop 
Wind Dancer
 for 
Mana Remnants
 (use 
Harmonic Remnants II
, 
Remnant Potency III
 and 
Khatal's Rejuvenation
 - For khatal you either need 
Dialla's Desire
 as well or 1 point into herald reservation

Keep in mind you don't need 
Fork
 on 
Ice Shot
 when doing pinnacle bosses, a good swap is 
Freeze
.

Don't use 
Elemental Armament III
, only level 2.

If you don't have the spirit or want to drop it, the spirit 
Mirage Archer
 can be dropped for 
Wind Dancer
(link with 
Blind II
 and 
Knockback
).

Early mapping gameplay:
You want to keep the buff from 
Freezing Mark
 up, has a 20 second duration. Besides that you're just using Ice shot, 
Snipe
 is only for map bosses. Optional: use 
Ice-Tipped Arrows



Boss rotation:
The goal is to freeze the boss into a 
Barrage
 
Snipe
 combo.

Pre-place 
Tornado Shot
, cast 
Ice-Tipped Arrows
, spam 
Ice Shot
 until the boss is frozen. Use 
Barrage
 into 
Snipe
. Make sure you still have a 
Tornado Shot
 down before casting barrage/snipe.

Weapon Set:
Follow the Weapon set I have above. Essentially you want all of your DPS skills on weapon set 1 and 
Freezing Mark
 on weapon set 2.

Take whatever attribute you need at the time, you'll default to dex if you don't need anything, after 161 dex you should default to strength for more HP.

This is a level 90 tree. If you need defense start taking the evasion/deflection nodes, otherwise just keep clicking the damage nodes.

If you have projectile speed on your quiver, you should also take 
Feathered Fletching
